name: platform-claude-marketplace
description: Internal Claude Code plugin marketplace. Install essentials to get started, then add individual plugins as your team needs them.

plugins.name: essentials
plugins.description: Start here. Curated starter pack: superpowers (TDD, debugging, planning, git worktrees), 7-phase feature development, and 6-agent parallel PR review — all in one install.

plugins.name: appsec
plugins.description: [Platform Team] 2 security scanning skills: appsec-scan (catalog-driven CI mirror — single-command scan (run-scan.sh) + normalized findings/triage statuses for small-model execution; admin-managed scanner preference profiles, 4 components from the private GitLab CI/CD Catalog (Fortify SCA SAST, Dependency Scanning SBOM, Secret Detection, Container Scanning) with per-component version pinning (~latest or exact tag); approval-gated fix loop and a guided Vulnerability Report triage plan) and appsec-dast-sim (LLM-based DAST following OWASP WSTG v4.2 — no running app required).

plugins.name: code-quality
plugins.description: [Platform Team] lint-and-validate (pre-commit gate with auto-fix formatters and linters — also in essentials), api-design-principles (REST/GraphQL + RFC 7807), openapi-spec-generation (keep OpenAPI 3.1 in sync), doc-coauthoring (ADRs, design docs, runbooks, postmortems).

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: [Vendored: obra/superpowers] 14 core developer skills: TDD, systematic debugging, planning, git worktrees, code review workflows, subagent-driven development, and more. Already bundled in essentials — install separately only if you want superpowers without the rest of essentials.

plugins.name: compound-engineering
plugins.description: [Vendored: EveryInc/compound-engineering-plugin] 38 skills + 50 specialised review agents: code review, architecture strategy, performance analysis, security review, data integrity, deployment verification, and more. Note: ce-gemini-imagegen requires GEMINI_API_KEY; ce-riffrec-feedback-analysis calls the OpenAI transcription API when OPENAI_API_KEY is set; ce-demo-reel can upload demo GIFs to public catbox.moe (user-approved); ce-release-notes/ce-update query the GitHub API.

plugins.name: gstack
plugins.description: [Vendored: garrytan/gstack] 54 developer productivity skills: QA, design consultation, browser automation, production safety gates (canary/guard/ship), context management, planning workflows, code review, benchmarking. Browser skills require Chrome.

plugins.name: ruflo
plugins.description: [Vendored: ruvnet/ruflo] 33 skills for AI swarm orchestration, AgentDB memory management (learning, vector-search, optimization), SPARC methodology, GitHub automation, and v3 architecture patterns. Swarm features (flow-nexus, hive-mind) require internet access.

plugins.name: getshitdone
plugins.description: [Vendored: gsd-build/get-shit-done] 66 slash commands covering the full Discuss→Plan→Execute→Verify lifecycle: /gsd task, /gsd plan, /gsd execute, /gsd verify, plus context management and team workflow commands.

plugins.name: anthropic-dev-skills
plugins.description: [Vendored: anthropics/skills] 4 skills for building with the Anthropic ecosystem: Claude API development (prompt caching, tool use, streaming, batch), MCP server building with vendored SDK reference, web app testing, and dual-mode agent patterns.

plugins.name: obsidian
plugins.description: [Vendored: kepano/obsidian-skills] 5 skills for Obsidian knowledge management: Markdown authoring, Bases queries, CLI usage, JSON Canvas diagrams, and content defuddle (simplification).

plugins.name: anthropic-feature-dev
plugins.description: [Vendored: anthropics/claude-plugins-official] 7-phase feature development workflow with 3 agents (code-architect, code-explorer, code-reviewer) and the /feature-dev slash command. Already bundled in essentials.

plugins.name: anthropic-pr-review
plugins.description: [Vendored: anthropics/claude-plugins-official] 6-agent parallel PR review toolkit: code simplicity, comment analysis, conversation context, test coverage, silent failure detection, type design. Plus /review-pr slash command. Already bundled in essentials.

plugins.name: anthropic-hookify
plugins.description: [Vendored: anthropics/claude-plugins-official] Git hooks framework for Claude Code: pre-commit, post-commit, and custom hook matchers. Includes the writing-rules skill and /hookify configuration command.

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: [Vendored: anthropics/skills] Frontend design patterns and best practices for building modern web UIs.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: [Vendored: DietrichGebert/ponytail] Lazy senior dev mode — forces the simplest, shortest solution that works: YAGNI, stdlib first, no unrequested abstractions. 6 skills (mode, review, audit, debt ledger, gain, help) plus session hooks that keep the mode active. Hooks require node on PATH.

plugins.name: agent-skills
plugins.description: [Vendored: addyosmani/agent-skills] 24 production-engineering skills (TDD, API design, security hardening, performance, planning, debugging, docs/ADRs) with a skill-discovery meta-skill injected at session start, plus 4 reviewer/auditor agents. Session hook requires jq (degrades gracefully). Note: source-driven-development needs doc access (internal mirror OK); browser-testing-with-devtools installs chrome-devtools-mcp via npx (npm mirror OK).

plugins.name: trailofbits-skills
plugins.description: [Vendored: trailofbits/skills] 33 security-engineering skills from Trail of Bits (curated subset of 17 upstream sub-plugins): audit context building, differential/variant analysis, Semgrep/CodeQL rule authoring, SARIF parsing, supply-chain and GitHub Actions auditing, insecure defaults, property-based/mutation testing, and the fuzzing testing-handbook. Some skills expect locally installed tools (semgrep, codeql, fuzzers); semgrep-rule-creator and testing-handbook-generator fetch external docs at runtime (internal mirror/proxy OK).
